facts.fact: On 24 March 2026 the APD issued deliberation 002/2026, a favourable opinion conditional on its remarks, on the joint decision authorising Maaden Mauritanie's Maadeni system, limiting recipients and interconnection to the national population register and GIMTEL CONNECT.

facts.fact: The APD met on 24 March 2026 under its president with eight named members, citing decree 2022-13 of 18 February 2022 on its composition and operation.
